report: Trachea and both main bronchi are open. No occlusive pathology. Aeration of both lung parenchyma is normal.
Findings consistent with viral pneumonia in both lungs. Ground-glass opacities in the upper and lower lobes.
Cardiomegaly with mild bilateral pleural effusion. Atelectatic changes in the right lower lobe.
Emphysematous changes in both upper lobes. No focal consolidation.
Multiple sub-centimeter lung nodules in the right upper lobe; follow-up recommended.
